Sanden Retail Systems Corporation.event: renamed to SDRS Inc. (SDRS株式会社)
Sanden Retail Systems Corporation.evidence: Sanden Retail Systems Corporation was acquired by Integral Corporation in 2019 and subsequently changed its corporate name to SDRS Inc. According to its official product catalog and company profile, its food equipment focus remains on vending machines, showcases, and commercial refrigeration rather than dedicated refrigeration-based soft-serve manufacturing machines.
